scenes.heading: Turning one shoot into a month of content

sents.d: Turning one shoot into a month of content
Repurpose a single client shoot across formats and weeks.

scenes.heading: One shoot, many pieces of content

sents.d: A single client shoot can usually produce far more than one final video: behind-the-scenes clips for your own social channels, short vertical cuts for Reels or TikTok, a client testimonial clip, and still frames for your portfolio site.

scenes.heading: Plan the repurposing before the shoot

sents.d: Plan for this repurposing before the shoot, not after — a few extra minutes capturing candid, behind-the-scenes moments during the shoot day gives you a month of content to post afterward.
This approach also markets your business passively: potential clients see your process, not just your finished product.

take: Plan extra clips on shoot day to fill a month of posts.
